mapper.select: SELECT X.MACHINENAME, X.ZONENAME, X.ACCESSMODE, X.INOUTTYPE, X.STATE, case when X.SUBPORTCNT < 2 then 2 else X.SUBPORTCNT end MAXCAPA, U.NAME PORTNAME, U.PORTTYPE, U.ACCEPTABLECARRIERTYPE, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='F' OR U.STATE='INSERVICE' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABILITY, X.FLOOR FROM NT_R_UNIT U, (SELECT M.TYPE AS EQPTYPE, M.STATE EQPSTATE, M.ACCEPTABLECARRIERTYPE, M.CARRIERTYPE, U.MACHINENAME, U.ZONENAME, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ACCESSMODE='AUTO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN ACCESSMODE='MANUAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'AUTO' ELSE 'MANUAL' END ACCESSMODE, MAX(CASE WHEN PORTTYPE='LP' THEN U.INOUTTYPE ELSE NULL END) INOUTTYPE, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN U.STATE!='INSERVICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'OUTOFSERVICE' ELSE 'INSERVICE' END STATE, COUNT(*) as SUBPORTCNT, max(case when u.zonename like '5ABL%1F%' or u.name like '5ABL%1F%' then 1 when u.zonename like '5ABL%3F%' or u.name like '5ABL%3F%' then 3 when u.zonename like u.machinename||'%A_3_' then 3 when u.zonename like u.machinename||'%A_7_' then 7 when u.zonename like '5ALF%A_3%' or u.zonename like '5ALF%M_3%' or u.zonename like '5ALF%A_G3%' then 3 when u.zonename like '5ALF%A_7%' or u.zonename like '5ALF%M_7%' or u.zonename like '5ALF%A_G7%' then 7 else 3 end ) FLOOR FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M WHERE M.ID = U.MACHINENAME AND U.UNITKIND NOT IN ('shelf','vehicle') AND M.TYPE='STOCKER' AND M.ID NOT LIKE '%\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%RM' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%FOUT' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE 'SEND%' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%F' GROUP BY M.TYPE, M.STATE , M.ACCEPTABLECARRIERTYPE, M.CARRIERTYPE, U.MACHINENAME, U.ZONENAME) X WHERE U.ZONENAME=X.ZONENAME AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%FOUT' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE 'SEND%' AND U.NAME NOT LIKE '%F' ORDER BY X.MACHINENAME, X.ZONENAME, U.NAME

SELECT MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN INOUTTYPE = 'OUT' and NAME like '%0_' then SUBSTR(NAME, 1, 15) WHEN INOUTTYPE = 'OUT' and NAME like '%1_' then SUBSTR(NAME, 1, 13)||'G1' WHEN INOUTTYPE = 'OUT' and NAME like '%2_' then SUBSTR(NAME, 1, 13)||'G2' WHEN INOUTTYPE = 'OUT' and NAME like '%8_' then SUBSTR(NAME, 1, 13)||'G8' ELSE SUBSTR(NAME, 1, 14) END AS CNVPORTNAME, ACCESSMODE, INOUTTYPE, STATE, NAME AS SUBPORTNAME, PORTTYPE, ACCEPTABLECARRIERTYPE, CASE WHEN BANNED='F' AND STATE='INSERVICE' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AS AVAILABILITY, MAXCAPACITY AS MAXCAPA FROM NT_R_UNIT WHERE MACHINENAME in (select ID from nt_r_machine where machinekind='interRail' and stk_typ='INTERAILSEMITS') AND PORTTYPE != 'BP' AND NAME not like '4AFC%G_' ORDER BY CNVPORTNAME, SUBPORTNAME

SELECT U.MACHINENAME, U.NAME, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='T' OR U.STATE !='INSERVICE' OR U.TRANSPORTUNITACCESSIBLE ='F' THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END AVAILABILITY, CASE WHEN U.USERFREADER='T' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END ISREADER, CASE WHEN N.ID IS NULL THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END ISN2 FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M, NT_E_N2MACHINE N WHERE U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND M.TYPE='STB' AND M.ID = N.MACHINENAME(+)

SELECT U.MACHINENAME, U.NAME, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='T' OR U.STATE !='INSERVICE' OR U.TRANSPORTUNITACCESSIBLE ='F' THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END AVAILABILITY FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M WHERE U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND M.MACHINEKIND='process' ORDER BY U.MACHINENAME, U.NAME

WITH T AS ( SELECT U.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN 'IN' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN 'IN' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN 'IN' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN 'OUT' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN 'OUT' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN 'OUT' ELSE U.NAME END GRPID, CASE WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN U.NAME WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN NULL WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN NULL WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN U.NAME WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN NULL WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN NULL ELSE U.NAME END GRPNAME, CASE WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN '1' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN '2' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN '3' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN '3' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='BP' AND U.MANUAL='F' AND U.INOUTTYPE='OUT' THEN '2' WHEN U.PORTTYPE='LP' AND U.MANUAL='T' AND U.INOUTTYPE='IN' THEN '1' ELSE U.NAME END OD, U.NAME SUBPORT, U.ACCESSMODE, CASE WHEN U.BANNED='F' AND U.STATE='INSERVICE' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABLE, U.PORTTYPE FROM NT_R_UNIT U, NT_R_MACHINE M WHERE U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND M.MACHINEKIND='interRail' AND M.KIND='INTERRAIL' AND (M.ID LIKE '_FIO%' OR M.ID LIKE '_FNC%') ) SELECT A.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN A.GRPID NOT IN ('IN','OUT') THEN 'BOTH' ELSE A.GRPID END INOUTTYPE, A.PORTNAME, B.OD, B.SUBPORT, B.ACCESSMODE, A.AVAILABLE, B.PORTTYPE FROM ( SELECT MACHINENAME, GRPID, MAX(GRPNAME) PORTNAME, MAX(CASE WHEN GRPNAME IS NOT NULL THEN AVAILABLE ELSE NULL END) AVAILABLE FROM T GROUP BY MACHINENAME, GRPID ) A, T B WHERE A.MACHINENAME=B.MACHINENAME AND A.GRPID = B.GRPID ORDER BY A.MACHINENAME, B.GRPID, B.OD

SELECT MACHINENAME, NAME, CASE WHEN BANNED='F' AND STATE='INSERVICE' THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABLE, CASE WHEN MACHINENAME LIKE '5ABL%' OR MACHINENAME LIKE '5AL%' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END MAXCAPA FROM NT_R_UNIT WHERE UNITKIND='crane'

SELECT Z.MACHINENAME, Z.NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN U.STATE='INSERVICE' AND U.BANNED='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) MAXCAPA, CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN U.STATE='INSERVICE' AND U.BANNED='F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) > 0 THEN 'T' ELSE 'F' END AVAILABLE, NVL(NVL(MAX(P.PROCESSTYPELIST),MAX(MP.PROCESSTYPELIST)),'ALL') PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_R_ZONE Z, NT_R_MACHINE M, NT_R_UNIT U, (SELECT MACHINENAME, ZONENAME, LISTAGG(PROCESSTYPENAME,',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY PROCESSTYPENAME) PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_T_ZONEPROCESSTYPE GROUP BY MACHINENAME, ZONENAME) P, (SELECT MACHINENAME, LISTAGG(PROCESSTYPENAME,',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY PROCESSTYPENAME) PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_T_MACHINEPROCESSTYPE GROUP BY MACHINENAME) MP WHERE Z.MACHINENAME = M.ID AND M.MACHINEKIND='storage' AND M.TYPE='STOCKER' AND Z.TYPE='SHELF' AND U.ZONENAME=Z.NAME AND U.MACHINENAME=M.ID AND M.ID NOT LIKE '%\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND Z.MACHINENAME NOT LIKE '%M10' AND Z.MACHINENAME = P.MACHINENAME(+) AND Z.NAME=P.ZONENAME(+) AND Z.MACHINENAME = MP.MACHINENAME(+) GROUP BY Z.MACHINENAME, Z.NAME

SELECT M.ID, CASE WHEN M.TYPE='STB' THEN 'STBGROUP' WHEN M.TYPE='PROCESS' THEN 'EQP' WHEN M.TYPE='STOCKER' THEN 'STK' WHEN M.TYPE='CONVEYOR' AND (M.ID LIKE '5FIO%' OR M.ID LIKE '5FNC%') THEN 'FIO' ELSE M.TYPE END EQPTYPE, CASE WHEN N.MACHINENAME IS NULL THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END ISN2, P.PROCESSTYPELIST, M.STK_TYP, DECODE(M.STATE,'INSERVICE','T','F') AVAILABLE, M.BAYNAME AS MCSBAYNM FROM NT_R_MACHINE M, NT_E_N2MACHINE N, (SELECT MACHINENAME, LISTAGG(PROCESSTYPENAME,',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY PROCESSTYPENAME) PROCESSTYPELIST FROM NT_T_MACHINEPROCESSTYPE GROUP BY MACHINENAME) P WHERE M.ID=N.MACHINENAME(+) AND M.ID=P.MACHINENAME(+) AND M.TYPE IN ('STB','PROCESS','STOCKER','CONVEYOR','OHT') AND (M.MACHINEKIND!='storage' OR M.HANDLETRANSPORTCOMMAND!='F' OR M.TYPE='STB') AND M.ID NOT LIKE '%\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND M.MACHINEKIND != 'interStorage' AND M.ID NOT IN ('INV001','TEST1234') ORDER BY 1
SELECT A.MACHINENAME || '_' || A.ALIASNAME AS ALIASNAME, A.MACHINENAME, A.UNITNAME FROM NT_R_UNITALIAS A

SELECT C.ID, C.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN U.TYPE='SHELF' THEN U.ZONENAME ELSE C.UNITNAME END UNITNAME, C.LOTID, C.BATCHID, CASE WHEN REGEXP_INSTR(C.BATCH_SEQ,'^[+-]?\d*(\.?\d*)$') = 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(C.BATCH_SEQ) ELSE -1 END BATCH_SEQ, C.PROCESSID AS ROUTER, C.STEPID, CASE WHEN C.STATE = 'WAITIN' THEN 'WAIT_IN' WHEN C.STATE='WAITOUT' THEN 'WAIT_OUT' WHEN C.STATE='MOVING' THEN 'TRANSFERRING' WHEN C.STATE='PIOERR' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE C.STATE END STATE, NVL(C.TYPE,'FOUP') TYPE, C.INSTALLTIME, C.N2_YN,--목적지가 N2일 경우 'N2'로 설정. 아니면 Null. 목적지에 도착하면 Clear됨 U.UNITKIND, J.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'TRANSFERRING' THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATED' THEN 'ALTERNATED' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATING' THEN 'ALTERNATING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE IS NULL THEN 'NONE' WHEN j.JOB_STATE = 'CREATED' OR j.JOB_STATE = 'QUEUING' THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE J.JOB_STATE END AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, J.SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY AS JOB_PRIORITY, CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN C.DESTMACHINENAME ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_EQP_ID, -- 타MCS간 반송일 경우 MES로 부터 받은 목적지를 넣어준다. CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN C.DESTUNITNAME ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_UNIT_ID, CASE WHEN CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID||'-0' END AS CMD_ID, CMD.STATE AS CMD_STATE, CMD.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME AS CMD_TR_MACHINE, CMD.TRANSPORTUNITNAME AS CMD_TR_UNIT, CMD.FROMMACHINENAME AS CMD_FROM_MACHINE, CMD.FROMUNITNAME AS CMD_FROM_UNIT, CMD.TOMACHINENAME AS CMD_TO_MACHINE, CMD.TOUNITNAME AS CMD_TO_UNIT, CMD.CREATETIME AS CMD_CRT_TM, CMD.PRIORITY AS CMD_PRIORITY, CMD.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT AS RETRYCOUNT
FROM NT_M_CARRIER C, NT_R_UNIT U, ( SELECT J.CARRIERNAME, J.ID AS JOB_ID, J.STATE AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN JSU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN JSU.ZONENAME ELSE J.SOURCEUNITNAME END SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.CREATETIME AS JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTJOB J, NT_R_UNIT JSU WHERE J.SOURCEMACHINENAME = JSU.MACHINENAME(+) AND J.SOURCEUNITNAME= JSU.NAME(+) )J, (SELECT CO.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID, CO.CARRIERNAME, CO.STATE, CO.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME, CO.TRANSPORTUNITNAME, CO.FROMMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN CU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN CU.ZONENAME ELSE CU.NAME END FROMUNITNAME, CO.TOMACHINENAME, CO.TOUNITNAME, CO.CREATETIME, CO.PRIORITY, CO.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTCMD CO, NT_R_UNIT CU WHERE CO.FROMUNITNAME = CU.NAME(+) AND CO.FROMMACHINENAME = CU.MACHINENAME(+) ) CMD WHERE C.MACHINENAME !='NA' AND C.STATE !='NA' and c.state != 'EVICTED' AND C.MACHINENAME=U.MACHINENAME AND C.UNITNAME = U.NAME AND C.ID = J.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = CMD.CARRIERNAME(+)

SELECT C.ID, C.MACHINENAME, CASE WHEN U.TYPE='SHELF' THEN U.ZONENAME ELSE C.UNITNAME END UNITNAME, C.LOTID, C.BATCHID, CASE WHEN REGEXP_INSTR(C.BATCH_SEQ,'^[+-]?\d*(\.?\d*)$') = 1 THEN TO_NUMBER(C.BATCH_SEQ) ELSE -1 END BATCH_SEQ, C.PROCESSID AS ROUTER, C.STEPID, CASE WHEN C.STATE = 'WAITIN' THEN 'WAIT_IN' WHEN C.STATE='WAITOUT' THEN 'WAIT_OUT' WHEN C.STATE='MOVING' THEN 'TRANSFERRING' WHEN C.STATE='PIOERR' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN C.STATE='NA' THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE C.STATE END STATE, NVL(C.TYPE,'FOUP') TYPE, C.INSTALLTIME, C.N2_YN,--목적지가 N2일 경우 'N2'로 설정. 아니면 Null. 목적지에 도착하면 Clear됨 U.UNITKIND, J.JOB_ID, CASE WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'TRANSFERRING' THEN 'PROCESSING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATED' THEN 'ALTERNATED' WHEN J.JOB_STATE = 'E84_ALTERNATING' THEN 'ALTERNATING' WHEN J.JOB_STATE IS NULL THEN 'NONE' WHEN j.JOB_STATE = 'CREATED' OR j.JOB_STATE = 'QUEUING' THEN 'QUEUED' ELSE J.JOB_STATE END AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, J.SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY AS JOB_PRIORITY, CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(F.DESTMACHINENAME,C.DESTMACHINENAME) ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_EQP_ID, -- 타MCS간 반송일 경우 MES로 부터 받은 목적지를 넣어준다. CASE WHEN J.JOB_ID IS NOT NULL THEN NVL(F.DESTUNITNAME,C.DESTUNITNAME) ELSE NULL END FINAL_MES_UNIT_ID, CASE WHEN CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CMD.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID||'-0' END AS CMD_ID, CMD.STATE AS CMD_STATE, CMD.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME AS CMD_TR_MACHINE, CMD.TRANSPORTUNITNAME AS CMD_TR_UNIT, CMD.FROMMACHINENAME AS CMD_FROM_MACHINE, CMD.FROMUNITNAME AS CMD_FROM_UNIT, CMD.TOMACHINENAME AS CMD_TO_MACHINE, CMD.TOUNITNAME AS CMD_TO_UNIT, CMD.CREATETIME AS CMD_CRT_TM, CMD.PRIORITY AS CMD_PRIORITY, CMD.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT AS RETRYCOUNT
FROM NT_M_CARRIER C, NT_R_UNIT U, ( SELECT J.CARRIERNAME, J.ID AS JOB_ID, J.STATE AS JOB_STATE, J.SOURCEMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN JSU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN JSU.ZONENAME ELSE J.SOURCEUNITNAME END SOURCEUNITNAME, J.DESTMACHINENAME, J.DESTUNITNAME, J.CREATETIME AS JOB_CRT_TM, J.CREATOR, J.PRIORITY FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTJOB J, NT_R_UNIT JSU WHERE J.SOURCEMACHINENAME = JSU.MACHINENAME(+) AND J.SOURCEUNITNAME= JSU.NAME(+) )J, (SELECT CO.TRANSPORTCOMMANDID, CO.CARRIERNAME, CO.STATE, CO.TRANSPORTMACHINENAME, CO.TRANSPORTUNITNAME, CO.FROMMACHINENAME, CASE WHEN CU.TYPE='SHELF' THEN CU.ZONENAME ELSE CU.NAME END FROMUNITNAME, CO.TOMACHINENAME, CO.TOUNITNAME, CO.CREATETIME, CO.PRIORITY, CO.CURRENTRETRYCOUNT FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTCMD CO, NT_R_UNIT CU WHERE CO.FROMUNITNAME = CU.NAME(+) AND CO.FROMMACHINENAME = CU.MACHINENAME(+) ) CMD, NT_F_FABTRANSPORTJOB F WHERE C.MACHINENAME !='NA' AND c.state != 'EVICTED' AND C.MACHINENAME=U.MACHINENAME AND C.UNITNAME = U.NAME AND C.ID = J.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = CMD.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = F.CARRIERNAME(+) AND C.ID = #{CARRIER_ID} AND C.ID IN (SELECT CARRIERNAME FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTJOB WHERE ID = #{JOB_ID}) AND C.ID IN (SELECT CARRIERNAME FROM NT_T_TRANSPORTCMD WHERE TRANSPORTUNITNAME = #{VHL_ID})
